facts.what: Cassie 染火红发、气色好转，从十分升到十五分（Blair 打分）
facts.anchor: Cassie Torrance has gone from a close ten to a solid fifteen.

facts.what: Blair 感激被邀同住；两人被同一个秘密绑住，但她也说本会喜欢她
facts.anchor: I think I’d have liked her anyway if we’d met another way.

facts.what: 不说 George；他死了她很高兴
facts.anchor: I’m fucking glad that the bastard is gone.

facts.what: Cassie 选后屋卧室；Blair 帮她翻新（粉墙、白地板、窗座）
facts.anchor: Her old Tarot reading room is now a far cry from something more fitting for a creepy old granny

facts.what: 首要任务是劝 Cassie 看医生；处方单由她代接
facts.anchor: I did it for her, grabbing the pink slip, and then her hand.

facts.what: Cassie 坦白读过「你的日记」且一直藏着
facts.anchor: I read it – your journal, I mean.

facts.what: Blair 内心：她从没有日记，自己书里只有 TITLE UNKNOWN 两字
facts.anchor: There’re only two words in it too: TITLE UNKNOWN.

relations: Cassie 与 Blair 同居；Blair 帮 Cassie 装新卧室、看医生
